## Checklist

- [ ] Linked to an issue (or includes a problem statement)
- [ ] `dotnet build` succeeds with no warnings
- [ ] `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` is clean
- [ ] `dotnet test` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added / updated for behavior changes
- [ ] If touching `~/.copilot/` parsing, fixture(s) added under `tests/fixtures/`
- [ ] Architectural changes include or update an ADR under `docs/adr/`
- [ ] User-visible changes have a screenshot or screencast
- [ ] No PII / secrets / prompts in logs, code, or commit messages
- [ ] Updated docs (README / CONTRIBUTING / docs) if applicable
